hero.subtitle_zh: 打造優質生活空間的專業夥伴
hero.subtitle_en: Your Professional Partner in Creating Quality Living Spaces

content_zh: 近年來社會快速變遷，各產業蓬勃發展，地球資源也隨之日益匱乏。因此，永續利用與環保意識愈加受到重視，鼓勵人們降低對自然環境的負擔。對多數民眾而言，傳統實木家具具備質感與風味，但在環保趨勢的推動下，愈來愈多人選擇以再生木材製成的系統家具。

豪板自 2003 年成立至今已超過 15 年，我們始終堅持使用環保建材，使品牌得以穩健成長。同時，我們也積極掌握設計潮流，推出符合大眾需求與風格的產品。目前豪板為義大利 Gruppo Mauro Saviola 的台灣總代理，產品為歐洲原裝進口的系統家具專用板材，並於台灣獨家銷售。所有板材皆採用低甲醛、無毒、防潮、防焰的環保配方，並通過歐盟 IDROLEB、日本 JIS F★★★★、台灣 SGS 等多項認證。
content_en: In recent years, rapid social changes and industrial growth have led to increasing depletion of global resources. As a result, sustainable resource use and environmental protection have become key concerns, encouraging society to reduce its impact on nature. While traditional solid-wood furniture is valued for its texture and character, the rising awareness of environmental sustainability has prompted many consumers to choose system furniture made from recycled wood materials.

Since its establishment in 2003, Hauboard has grown steadily for more than 15 years, driven by our commitment to environmentally friendly building materials. We continue to stay aligned with design trends, offering products that meet modern lifestyle needs. Hauboard is currently the exclusive distributor in Taiwan for Italy's Gruppo Mauro Saviola, providing system-furniture panels that are fully manufactured in Europe and exclusively sold in Taiwan. Our materials feature low formaldehyde, non-toxic, moisture-resistant, and flame-retardant properties, and are certified by leading international standards including the EU IDROLEB, Japan's JIS F★★★★, and Taiwan's SGS.

content_zh: 提供最優質的裝飾板材產品，滿足客戶多樣化的設計需求。

content_en: Provide the highest quality decorative panel products to meet diverse customer design needs.
Adhere to environmental principles by selecting eco-friendly materials that meet international standards.
Provide professional consultation services to help customers realize their ideal spaces.
